t: This is St John the Evangelist's Church, an Anglican church in the Vanbrugh Park area of Blackheath. It was built in the 1850s to a design by Arthur Ashpitel, and it was meant to give a rapidly growing, well-to-do residential area an important visual and spiritual focus. Ashpitel trained under his father, set up his own practice in 1842, and also designed St Barnabas in Homerton. Today the church has an Evangelical character, holds two services on a Sunday, and runs lively children's and youth groups.
